intro: Return to Quinn (Again) is a delivery quest in Silverpine Forest where a courier brings a restorative alchemical mixture to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch. The specialized concoction prevents Quinn from deteriorating into a mindless ghoul, restoring his strength so he may resume traveling.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.
Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I can feel it working. I will soon be able to travel.
You have done me a great favor, friend.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
